prompt:
Soft-focus fine-art photograph of a single pale blush lotus flower floating on still water at dawn, light mist, warm cream light, muted palette of #F8EFEA, #F0D3C3 and #BF7F7F, the flower small in the lower third with calm open space above.

House style: Warm, calm, precise; an atelier for lash and brow professionals. Cream, blush and dusty rose; soft window light from the upper right; natural stone and satin; generous negative space. Editorial beauty still life, never glossy advertising, never clinical.

Do not include: several flowers, frogs, people, text, logos, saturated pink, dark water, lily pads covering the frame. Never: products, bottles, tubes, jars, boxes, packaging or labels; text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or brand marks; faces, eyes, lashes or brows; before-and-after or treatment results; a recognisable person; stock clichés: flowers scattered on marble, fanned makeup brushes, spa stones, candles, champagne, gold glitter.

Photographic, natural, no illustration look, no AI gloss, no watermark.
